blocks.subtitle: Everything you need to know about CUET 2027 registration dates, application deadlines, exam schedule, correction window, and admission timeline.

blocks.alt: CUET 2027 Registration Date and Application Form

blocks.content: Students planning to appear for the Common University Entrance Test (CUET UG) 2027 must stay updated with the latest CUET 2027 registration date, application process, and important deadlines. Missing even a single deadline can prevent candidates from applying for admission to top universities such as Delhi University, Banaras Hindu University, Jawaharlal Nehru University, Jamia Millia Islamia, Allahabad University, and many other institutions that accept CUET scores. This guide covers everything students need to know regarding CUET 2027 registration, eligibility, application form dates, correction windows, exam schedule, and important instructions.
CUET 2027 Registration Date (Expected Schedule)

The National Testing Agency (NTA) is expected to release the CUET 2027 application form during the first quarter of 2027. While official dates will be announced later, students should begin preparation early and keep all required documents ready.
Why Is the CUET Registration Date Important?

Thousands of students miss admission opportunities every year due to incomplete applications, payment failures, or missed deadlines. Knowing the CUET registration schedule helps students complete applications on time, choose the correct subjects, upload documents correctly, and avoid last-minute technical issues.
Who Can Apply for CUET 2027?

Students appearing for Class 12 board examinations in 2027 or those who have already passed Class 12 from a recognized board can apply for CUET UG 2027. Individual universities may have additional eligibility requirements regarding minimum marks, subject combinations, and reservation criteria.
How to Fill CUET 2027 Application Form

blocks.alt: CUET 2027 Application Process Step by Step

blocks.content: The CUET registration process is completed online. Students should carefully follow all instructions while filling out the application form.
Documents Required for CUET 2027 Registration
Before starting the application process, students should keep all required documents ready to ensure a smooth registration experience.
Common Mistakes Students Make During Registration

Students often select incorrect subjects, upload unclear photographs, enter incorrect personal information, use inactive email addresses, or fail to complete fee payment successfully. Every detail should be verified carefully before final submission.
How to Prepare Before Registration Opens

Students should research their target universities, understand course eligibility criteria, decide subject combinations, gather required documents, and begin CUET preparation well before registration begins. Early planning helps avoid confusion during the application process.
What Happens After CUET Registration?

After registration closes, students can make corrections during the correction window if allowed. The NTA then releases the exam city slip, admit card, conducts the examination, publishes answer keys, announces results, and universities begin counseling and admission processes.

items.question: When will CUET 2027 registration start?
items.answer: The registration process is expected to begin in February 2027. Students should wait for the official notification from NTA.

items.question: Can I edit my CUET application form after submission?
items.answer: Yes, NTA generally provides a correction window during which eligible details can be modified.

items.question: Is CUET mandatory for Delhi University admission?
items.answer: Most undergraduate admissions at Delhi University are conducted through CUET scores.

items.question: Can Class 12 appearing students apply for CUET 2027?
items.answer: Yes, students appearing in Class 12 board examinations in 2027 can apply.

items.question: What happens if I miss the CUET registration deadline?
items.answer: Candidates who miss the registration deadline generally cannot apply unless NTA extends the application period.
